description: Cobbled grey plates, green standing wet in every joint. In a blade the poison layers on and never clears out.
lore: It travels alone, at the bottom of the bag, with something folded between it and the rest, because the green gets out — not much, never fast, never stopping. A pouch that has carried one for a season is marked inside for good. The crackers' rule is flat: you carry one of these, or you carry the rest.

So somebody has to walk the green bag, and the somebody is [[characters/cfe826c1|Jehanne]]. She took the office unasked, the way she takes every office no one else wants, and walks a day behind the buying party with the bag on a pole over her shoulder, washing her hands at every stream, saying over each stone the blessing of a faith she tells everyone she no longer holds. The trade pays her in firewood. She has never once been robbed.

Graders can usually say inside a minute whether the thing in their hand is a fact, an appetite, or a habit. This one is none of the three. It is a substance — the same green [[monsters/malformed_creature|the Palehusk]] leaks — and a substance is not a life pressed small. It grades high anyway. High enough that the question rarely gets asked twice.
